transcript.text: Work seems like a performance sometimes. I really wonder, what would I have become? Nobody was watching. What do I truly desire? Maybe the answer lies somewhere between both sides of me. Because no matter which version of me shows up, I want my children to feel right. And that's what I love about Shiva. There's something for every side of me. Different modes, different styles, one constant. Shiva.
